say:0:1410701001:0.text: I've searched the area. There's a stone bridge to the west.
say:0:1410701001:0.source_cn: 我仔细观察了一圈，西边有一座宏伟的石桥。

say:1:1410701002:0.text: I believe that bridge leads to where we want to go.
say:1:1410701002:0.source_cn: 我认为那座桥通向我们想去的地方。

say:0:1410702101:0.text: I knew there would be guards here. A fight was inevitable.
say:0:1410702101:0.source_cn: 我就知道这里会有守卫，免不了一战了。

say:0:1410704001:0.text: Hey, a big rock fell from the guard. This is...
say:0:1410704001:0.source_cn: 守卫身上掉下来一块大石头，这是……

say:2:1410704101:2.text: Ugh... this rock is as heavy as a dragon's hoard! It was so loud when it fell!
say:2:1410704101:2.source_cn: 呃……好沉的石头，掉在地上咣当一声！

say:3:1410704102:0.text: This isn't an ordinary stone. There's an odd symbol on it.
say:3:1410704102:0.source_cn: 这不是普通石头，它的表面有金属质感。我看不懂上面的符号。

say:4:1410704103:0.text: Oh, it's an <style="highlight">ancient rune</style>! These were commonly used during the heyday of the Ironheart Dominion when our ancestors ruled.

choice_prompt:5:1410704103.text: Oh, it's an <style="highlight">ancient rune</style>! These were commonly used during the heyday of the Ironheart Dominion when our ancestors ruled.
choice_prompt:5:1410704103.source_cn: 啊，古代符文！在我们祖先钢心帝国的鼎盛时期曾被广泛使用。

say:6:1410704104:2.text: Let me take a closer look. Hmm... this rune looks like a number to me.
say:6:1410704104:2.source_cn: 我仔细看看啊，这种符文应该代表着数字。

say:7:1410704105:1.text: If I remember correctly, this is the symbol for <style="highlight">one</style>.
say:7:1410704105:1.source_cn: 我没记错的话，它代表的数字是……<style=high...

say:8:1410704106:0.text: Eldric likes to design all kinds of mechanisms, and this stone may be the key to opening everything.
say:8:1410704106:0.source_cn: 弗林那家伙喜欢设计各种各样的机关，这块石头，很可能是开...

say:9:1410704107:0.text: If there's one, there might be others.
say:9:1410704107:0.source_cn: 既然有一，说不定还有二三四。

say:10:1410704108:0.text: Anyway, let's take it with us. Oh, since it's important, we'll leave it in your safe hands, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1410704108:0.male: Anyway, let's take it with us. Oh, since it's important, we'll leave it in your safe hands, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:10:1410704108:0.female: Anyway, let's take it with us. Oh, since it's important, we'll leave it in your safe hands, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:0:1410705001:0.text: The scale of this building is truly daunting.
say:0:1410705001:0.source_cn: 这座建筑的规模真是可怕。弗林……算你有本事。

say:1:1410707001:1.text: It was really here... It's the Eclipsion!
say:1:1410707001:1.source_cn: 真的在这里！杜恩加尔……是杜恩加尔！

say:2:1410707002:1.text: Eldric! You despicable man! No wonder you were so confident about resurrecting Helthor... You had the Eclipsion this whole time!
say:2:1410707002:1.source_cn: 弗林！这可恶的小老头……怪不得他对复活赫托信心十足……...

say:3:1410707003:1.text: Let's take a deep breath. It may be just a replica.
say:3:1410707003:1.source_cn: 你冷静下来仔细看看，我怀疑只是个仿品。

say:4:1410707004:1.text: Use your eyes! I know I'm right. Helthor himself forged that weapon with the flames of a dragon!
say:4:1410707004:1.source_cn: 轮不到你怀疑！我相信我的眼睛！错不了，那可是赫托亲手用...

say:5:1410707005:1.text: Even if it's far away, even if I don't understand magic... I can feel the power it exudes!
say:5:1410707005:1.source_cn: 即便离得这么远，即便不懂魔法……我也能感受到它散发出来...

say:6:1410707006:1.text: The Eclipsion cannot be replicated. No doubt it's the real deal!
say:6:1410707006:1.source_cn: 杜恩加尔根本不可能被仿造！毋庸置疑，那是真品！

say:7:1410707007:1.text: Strange... There's a dark energy around that bow.
say:7:1410707007:1.source_cn: 怪了……那把弓上附有阴暗黏腻的气息。

say:8:1410707008:1.text: Although it's very weak, it's definitely not divine power.
say:8:1410707008:1.source_cn: 虽然气息很微弱，但我认为那绝对不是神明的力量。

choice_prompt:9:1410707008.text: Although it's very weak, it's definitely not divine power.
choice_prompt:9:1410707008.source_cn: 虽然气息很微弱，但我认为那绝对不是神明的力量。

say:10:1410707009:1.text: I'm familiar with the queen's magic. The two are not the same.
say:10:1410707009:1.source_cn: 我熟悉女王的魔力，二者并不相似，不是女王。

say:11:1410707012:1.text: Something foul has tainted the Eclipsion...?
say:11:1410707012:1.source_cn: 你们在讨论什么啊？听着像是有什么脏东西玷污了杜恩加尔，...

say:12:1410707013:1.text: It does seem to have been tampered with.
say:12:1410707013:1.source_cn: 很形象的比喻，你的理解没错。

say:13:1410707014:1.text: But that's THE Eclipsion! Who has that type of power?! Not to mention, it's been lost for so long. I mean... this person would have to be as powerful as Helthor or the Primordial Dragon!
say:13:1410707014:1.source_cn: 喂……那可是杜恩加尔，谁有这么大的本领！且不说它失落已...

say:14:1410707015:1.text: You must be mistaken! Let's go take a closer look.
say:14:1410707015:1.source_cn: 你们一定是搞错了，走近点再看看吧！

say:16:1410707010:1.text: I've never laid eyes on a Hypogean. However, I've heard tales of them but not much else.
say:16:1410707010:1.source_cn: 恶魔吗……我对它们不太了解。我从未亲眼见过恶魔，只零星...

say:17:1410707011:1.text: But dwarves cannot use any magic, let alone infuse a weapon with magical power.
say:17:1410707011:1.source_cn: 可是矮人并不会使用魔法，更谈不上将魔力留在那把武器上了。

say:0:1410708001:0.text: If those were real traces of a Hypogean, why would one be lurking around Helthor's temple?
say:0:1410708001:0.source_cn: 如果那是恶魔的气息，为什么会有恶魔蛰伏在赫托的神殿呢？
say:0:1410708001:0.male: If those were real traces of a Hypogean, why would one be lurking around Helthor's temple?
say:0:1410708001:0.female: If those were real traces of a Hypogean, why would one be lurking around Helthor's temple?

say:1:1410708002:0.text: Did Eldric do something? That stone-sucking son of a mole! What in Esperia is he trying to do?
say:1:1410708002:0.source_cn: 这……是不是弗林做了什么？该死！他到底想做什么？

say:0:1410708101:0.text: Temples... Hypogeans... These statues along the way and the pedestals beside them...
say:0:1410708101:0.source_cn: 神殿……恶魔……沿途这些雕像，还有旁边的台座……
say:0:1410708101:0.male: Temples... Hypogeans... These statues along the way and the pedestals beside them...
say:0:1410708101:0.female: Temples... Hypogeans... These statues along the way and the pedestals beside them...

say:1:1410708102:0.source_cn: 这一切应该都有所关联……

say:0:1410712101:0.text: There were a few empty seats near the entrance...
say:0:1410712101:0.source_cn: 我们刚进来的地方，有几个空台座……
say:0:1410712101:0.male: There were a few empty seats near the entrance...
say:0:1410712101:0.female: There were a few empty seats near the entrance...

say:1:1410712102:0.text: Well, we have to go and check it out. We can't go anywhere else anyway.
say:1:1410712102:0.source_cn: 唔，那得去看看，别的地方我们也去不了。走吧，过去瞧瞧！

say:0:1410714001:0.text: The rune appearing here... it says <style="highlight">two</style>...

say:1:1410714002:0.text: The words below are the same as before.
say:1:1410714002:0.source_cn: 下面的字跟之前的一样。

say:0:1410715001:0.text: Oh, the rune that emerged... It says <style="highlight">three</style> on it...
say:0:1410715001:0.source_cn: 哎呀，这浮现出的符文……唔！是<style=highl...

say:1:1410715002:0.text: These words below... <style="highlight">"The sacred key must take its place..."</style>

say:0:1410716001:0.text: This is <style="highlight">four</style>, so the one opposite is <style="highlight">one</style>!

say:1:1410717001:0.text: "The sacred key must take its place, where first it lay in time and space. Align it well, as stars have shown. And through its gate, the path is known."
say:1:1410717001:0.source_cn: 以铸造之序，置圣钥于座。依序而行，真路可开。

say:2:1410717002:1.text: I knew there was a mechanism here. All that fancy wording, and it's just telling us to put the <style="highlight">keys</style> on the pedestal in order!
say:2:1410717002:1.source_cn: 果然有机关。这些文字表面上很高深，实际就是要我们按照顺...

say:6:1410717004:1.text: Alright, let me look for the corresponding order of the runes and find the corresponding pedestal for <style="highlight">one</style>...
say:6:1410717004:1.source_cn: 不着急，我先找找对应的顺序和符文，对应<style=h...

choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 试试之前那块符文石板

say:0:1410719001:0.text: It's Essail magic. I can't interact with it.
say:0:1410719001:0.source_cn: 是艾塞勒的术式，我似乎无法干预。
say:0:1410719001:0.male: It's Essail magic. I can't interact with it.
say:0:1410719001:0.female: It's Essail magic. I can't interact with it.

say:1:1410719002:0.text: Then, what should we do? Hey, Indris, think of a solution!
say:1:1410719002:0.source_cn: 那可怎么办？喂，因度厄，你想想办法！

say:0:1410721001:0.text: Oh, we did it! We... *BARF*... Oh, my head...
say:0:1410721001:0.source_cn: 成……成功了！我们——呕！天、天旋地转……

say:1:1410721002:0.text: Teleportation takes a toll... Do you need some water?
say:1:1410721002:0.male: Teleportation takes a toll... Do you need some water?
say:1:1410721002:0.female: Teleportation takes a toll... Do you need some water?

say:1:1410727001:0.text: Your Majesty! Captain Indris has conspired with the dwarves and outsiders to unearth the secrets of the Divine Dew.
say:1:1410727001:0.source_cn: 陛下！因度厄卫队长勾结矮人和异族魔法师，窥探到了恩典灵...

say:2:1410727002:0.text: What he has done threatens the sacred order of Sal'thorin. I beg you to deliver a judgment befitting this treachery.
say:2:1410727002:0.source_cn: 他的所作所为已经严重威胁萨洛克兰的根基，恳请您降下公正...

say:4:1410727003:0.text: What say you, Indris? Two foreign ones walk among us. This very moment may be your reckoning, for your words will seal your fate.
say:4:1410727003:0.source_cn: 说说吧，因度厄，还有两位来自异族的访客。此刻，为自己辩...

say:6:1410727004:0.text: Your Majesty... your appearance... May I inquire what has transpired?
say:6:1410727004:0.source_cn: 女王陛下……您这副样貌究竟是……？

say:8:1410727005:0.text: Indris, how dare you question Her Majesty so? Such insolence is unforgivable!
say:8:1410727005:0.source_cn: 因度厄，你怎敢向陛下提出如此失礼的问题！

say:10:1410727006:0.text: Calm your ire, Velara. Such a bold spirit is not commonly found.
say:10:1410727006:0.source_cn: 镇静，奎茵。这般炽烈的灵魂之火已经很少见了。

say:11:1410727007:0.text: Indris, hear me. I am not a dragon. I am Essail.
say:11:1410727007:0.source_cn: 因度厄，我不是龙，我是一名纯粹的艾塞勒。

say:12:1410727008:0.text: Yet, thousands of years ago, Misarte, the goddess of the earth and rivers, cast a curse upon us, banishing us from the Dark Forest.
say:12:1410727008:0.source_cn: 但是，在千年以前，弥萨忒……大地与河川之神诅咒了我们，...

say:13:1410727009:0.text: In my struggle against her curse, I sought the strength of dragons... and through the years, I have transformed into this.
say:13:1410727009:0.source_cn: 为了与祂的诅咒抗衡，我不得不借助龙的力量……长此以来，...

choice_prompt:14:1410727009.text: In my struggle against her curse, I sought the strength of dragons... and through the years, I have transformed into this.
choice_prompt:14:1410727009.source_cn: 为了与祂的诅咒抗衡，我不得不借助龙的力量……长此以来，便成了这幅样貌。

say:16:1410727010:0.text: Yes, she denied us the rivers' embrace and the warmth of the light.
say:16:1410727010:0.source_cn: 正是。祂不允许我们饮用河川之水，不允许我们踏足光照之地。

say:18:1410727011:0.text: It was once our home, yet due to a single misstep, all our efforts were undone by Misarte, and she cast us out.
say:18:1410727011:0.source_cn: 那里是我们的故乡，然而，只因一点小小的过失，我们的辛苦...

say:20:1410727012:0.text: Our ancestors were not driven from their homeland by the Hypogeans, but rather cast out by a god?
say:20:1410727012:0.source_cn: 我们的祖先之所以流离失所，并非故土被恶魔侵袭，而是被那...

say:21:1410727013:0.text: You're telling me everything we've been taught about our history... <shk>was it all a lie?</shk>
say:21:1410727013:0.source_cn: 民众们一直以来得知的历史……<shk>都是假的？</shk>

say:23:1410727014:0.text: We, Essail, carry a curse from a goddess... I doubt our people could endure such a bitter revelation.
say:23:1410727014:0.source_cn: 艾塞勒被神明诅咒，我认为民众无法承受这样残忍的真相。

say:25:1410727015:0.text: Another curse... If that's the case, you Essail and us dwarves are in the same boat.
say:25:1410727015:0.source_cn: 又是诅咒……从这一点上来说，你们艾塞勒和我们矮人真是同...

say:27:1410727016:0.text: Why did you lie to our people?
say:27:1410727016:0.source_cn: 为什么你要对艾塞勒撒谎？

say:29:1410727017:0.text: I spoke no falsehood. The land Misarte forbade us to walk is far more dreadful than any epic could ever capture.
say:29:1410727017:0.source_cn: 我没有撒谎，弥萨忒不允许我们踏足的地面，比史诗中描绘得...

say:31:1410727018:0.text: Hmph! How dreadful could the surface be? Indris will know once he sees it for himself!
say:31:1410727018:0.source_cn: 哼，地面到底是什么样子，等因度厄自己去看看就知道了！

say:32:1410727019:0.text: Queen of the Essail, my ancestors enraged the dragons and got cursed for it. What did you do to get the goddess all riled up?
say:32:1410727019:0.source_cn: 艾塞勒的女王！我的祖先们触怒了龙，因此遭到诅咒，你们又...

say:34:1410727020:0.text: The gods are fickle. We only sought to protect our homeland...
say:34:1410727020:0.source_cn: 呵，神明，不可捉摸。我们也只是为了保卫生存的家园……

say:35:1410727021:0.text: In the end, only the power of the Primordial Dragon could stand against Misarte's curse. We had no choice in the matter at that time.
say:35:1410727021:0.source_cn: 总之，只有利用初始之龙的力量，才能对抗弥萨忒的诅咒，那...

say:37:1410727022:0.text: But we transform into monsters once we stop drinking the dragon egg essence. Is this not another kind of curse?
say:37:1410727022:0.source_cn: 可是一旦停止饮用龙的蛋清，我们便会异化成可怕的怪物，这...

say:39:1410727023:0.text: Why halt? The Primordial Dragon births even in slumber. Truly, it is a creature of unparalleled wonder.
say:39:1410727023:0.source_cn: 为什么要停止呢？初始之龙即便在沉睡时也会不断地产下子嗣...

say:40:1410727024:0.text: So long as we partake in the Divine Dew, none shall transform into the monsters you so dread.
say:40:1410727024:0.source_cn: 只要我们继续饮用恩典灵露，没人会变成你所畏惧的怪物。不是吗？

say:41:1410727025:0.text: To us, the dragon eggs are inexhaustible—a gift from the very depths, the light of life, a blessing from Esperia.
say:41:1410727025:0.source_cn: 龙蛋取之不尽，用之不竭，这是地下的馈赠，是伊索米亚给予...

say:43:1410727026:0.text: Every gift has a price, and your body is the best proof of that.
say:43:1410727026:0.source_cn: 任何馈赠都有代价，你这副身体是最好的证据。

say:44:1410727027:1.text: I mean, you drank dragon egg essence every day, and you still ended up looking like this.
say:44:1410727027:1.source_cn: 就算你天天把龙的蛋清当水喝，还不是变成了这副可怕的模样？

say:46:1410727028:0.text: Insolent wretch! Were it not for her devotion to protecting her people, Her Majesty would never have been subjected to this mutation!
say:46:1410727028:0.source_cn: 放肆！若不是为了保护子民，女王陛下本无需受异变之苦！

say:47:1410727029:0.text: Her Majesty is bound by her duty to uphold the peace of Sal'thorin, and thus, she consumes the Divine Dew in great measure to draw strength. Her altered appearance is but a testament to her unparalleled greatness!
say:47:1410727029:0.source_cn: 女王陛下需要维护萨洛克兰的安宁，所以才会过度地服用灵露...

say:48:1410727030:0.text: You, foolish outsiders, cannot comprehend the noble intentions of the queen!
say:48:1410727030:0.source_cn: 愚昧的外来者……你们无法理解女王的良苦用心！

say:50:1410727031:0.text: Please calm yourself, Velara. I trust Indris will comprehend the necessity of my choice as ruler of the Essail.
say:50:1410727031:0.source_cn: 奎茵，冷静。我相信，因度厄能理解我身为统治者的决断。

say:51:1410727032:0.text: Consider it, Indris. If the clan were to discover the truth, the weight of their suffering would be unbearable.
say:51:1410727032:0.source_cn: 想想吧，因度厄。如果族人突然得知一切的真相，他们的心灵...

say:55:1410727034:0.text: You see, even a spirit as strong as yours is not untouched by the weight of such a cruel reality.
say:55:1410727034:0.source_cn: 看吧，即便是你这样坚毅如磐石的灵魂，也会被这残酷的真相...

choice_prompt:56:1410727034.text: You see, even a spirit as strong as yours is not untouched by the weight of such a cruel reality.
choice_prompt:56:1410727034.source_cn: 看吧，即便是你这样坚毅如磐石的灵魂，也会被这残酷的真相所动摇。

say:57:1410727035:4.text: I understand... I know what I have to do.
say:57:1410727035:4.source_cn: 我明白……我已经有判断了。
say:57:1410727035:4.male: I understand... I know what I have to do.
say:57:1410727035:4.female: I understand... I know what I have to do.

say:58:1410727041:1.text: Your Majesty, though despair may grip the hearts of many, fleeing from it will only lead us further from the path we must walk.
say:58:1410727041:1.source_cn: 女王陛下，也许人们一开始会感到绝望，但是，逃避只会让我...

say:59:1410727042:1.text: Your people are much stronger than you think. They have the right to know the truth, and they will face it together with you.
say:59:1410727042:1.source_cn: 您的族人远比您想象中坚强，他们有权知道真相，他们会与您...

say:60:1410727043:0.text: Yeah! Who knows if this curse that goddess supposedly put on you is true or not? It could just be something she made up—words aren't enough to prove it.
say:60:1410727043:0.source_cn: 而且，谁知道那个神明降下的诅咒是真是假？口说无凭，指不...

say:62:1410727044:0.text: As you wish, I shall fulfill your request.

say:63:1410727045:0.text: Velara, Thador, reveal to our guests the true horror of this curse.
say:63:1410727045:0.source_cn: 奎茵，都铎，为客人们展现那恶毒的诅咒吧。

say:65:1410727036:4.text: Got it! I shouldn't kick him in the head though, right? Might knock something loose...
say:65:1410727036:4.source_cn: 得令！我能踹他脑袋上不？
say:65:1410727036:4.male: Got it! I shouldn't kick him in the head though, right? Might knock something loose...
say:65:1410727036:4.female: Got it! I shouldn't kick him in the head though, right? Might knock something loose...

say:67:1410727038:1.text: Good! You look more like yourself now! Stay firm and say what you have to say.
say:67:1410727038:1.source_cn: 很好，这下子你应该清醒多了。坚定一点！

say:68:1410727039:1.text: My resolve is the same as always. I was just thinking about how to phrase my words.
say:68:1410727039:1.source_cn: 我没有动摇，我只是在思考该如何表述。

choice:56:1:2.text: Zanie, he needs a good kick.
choice:56:1:2.male: Zanie, he needs a good kick.
choice:56:1:2.female: Zanie, he needs a good kick.

say:69:1410727040:4.text: Don't worry. I won't hesitate because of her words.
say:69:1410727040:4.source_cn: 放心，我已经不会因为这些话而犹豫了。

narration:1:1410728001:0.text: After a tense silence, Velara and Thador return, escorting two members of the Essail clan. The air thickens with anticipation as their presence looms large.
narration:1:1410728001:0.source_cn: 一段时间后，奎茵和都铎带来了两位艾塞勒……

say:1:1410729001:0.text: Open your eyes and behold the true visage of this curse...
say:1:1410729001:0.source_cn: 睁开你们的双眼，见证诅咒的真实面目吧。

say:2:1410729002:0.text: To become monsters devoid of reason, driven solely by the urge to slaughter our own kind...
say:2:1410729002:0.source_cn: 是堕为没有理智，只会戕害同胞的怪物——

say:3:1410729003:0.text: ...or shall we explore every path, no matter the cost, to survive and reclaim our own destiny?
say:3:1410729003:0.source_cn: 还是用尽一切手段活下去，重新掌握自己的命运？

say:1:1410731001:0.text: Indris, I ask you, what is your choice?
say:1:1410731001:0.source_cn: 因度厄，告诉我，你的抉择是什么？

say:5:1410731003:0.text: Don't hesitate. Accept Her Majesty's guidance and favor. Just like I did years ago...
say:5:1410731003:0.source_cn: 不必犹豫，接受女王陛下的指引吧。如同当年的我……

say:7:1410731005:0.text: Yes, I, too, delved into the mystery of the Divine Dew, questioning its nature and the path Her Majesty chose to follow.
say:7:1410731005:0.source_cn: 我也曾独自探寻恩典灵露的真相，我也曾质疑女王陛下做出的选择。

say:8:1410731006:0.text: The path you are walking now is a path I have walked before.
say:8:1410731006:0.source_cn: 你现在走过的路，我也曾踏上。

say:9:1410731007:1.text: But you still chose to cover up the truth with the queen?!
say:9:1410731007:1.source_cn: 但你仍然选择和女王他们一起掩盖真相？！

say:10:1410731008:0.text: Cover up? No... When I witnessed the truth of the forbidden land and endured the pain of the curse, I realized that the path Her Majesty chose is the only one that offers any glimmer of hope.
say:10:1410731008:0.source_cn: 掩盖？不，当亲自见到禁地的真相，亲身体会了诅咒的痛苦，...

say:11:1410731009:0.text: Indris... When I look at you, I am reminded of the days when I, too, was impulsive and blind, believing that revealing the truth could somehow set everything right.
say:11:1410731009:0.source_cn: 因度厄……看着你，我会想起曾经的自己也如此冲动天真。自...

say:12:1410731010:0.text: However, in the face of this despairing truth, the Essail have no other path forward. To avoid succumbing to our tragic fate, we can only choose this path, even if it's cruel.
say:12:1410731010:0.source_cn: 然而在绝望的真相面前，艾塞勒没有别的路可走。为了不臣服...

say:13:1410731011:0.text: There is no shame in survival. Ignorance is a kindness.
say:13:1410731011:0.source_cn: 求生并不可耻。愚昧才是仁慈。

say:14:1410731012:0.text: In time, you will understand. With boundless mercy, Her Majesty forgave my past arrogance. I can only hope she grants you the same grace, Indris.
say:14:1410731012:0.source_cn: 你会理解的。女王陛下以她的慈悲宽宥了僭越独行的我，希望...

say:16:1410731013:0.text: Thador, the past need not be revisited. Your loyalty was proven long ago.
say:16:1410731013:0.source_cn: 都铎，不用记挂那些小小过失了，你早已向我展现了自己的忠诚。

say:18:1410731014:0.text: I'm grateful for your boundless patience and understanding.

say:20:1410731015:0.text: Indris… Drink the Divine Dew and submit to my rule. Do so, and I shall grant you the power to defy fate.
say:20:1410731015:0.source_cn: 因度厄……饮下恩典灵露，臣服于我的统治。我将赐予你对抗...

say:22:1410731016:0.text: Forgive me for being so blunt, Your Majesty, but I would rather face this curse than pay such a price for survival.
say:22:1410731016:0.source_cn: ……恕我直言，陛下。我宁愿直面诅咒，也不愿用如此代价换...

say:24:1410731017:0.text: Your courage is commendable, but it is wasted on reckless foolishness.

say:25:1410731018:0.text: Who gave you this courage? Was it you there, mage from the surface?
say:25:1410731018:0.source_cn: 是谁给予了你这份勇气，是那位来自异族的魔法师吗？
say:25:1410731018:0.male: Who gave you this courage? Was it you there, mage from the surface?
say:25:1410731018:0.female: Who gave you this courage? Was it you there, mage from the surface?

choice_prompt:26:1410731018.text: Who gave you this courage? Was it you there, mage from the surface?
choice_prompt:26:1410731018.source_cn: 是谁给予了你这份勇气，是那位来自异族的魔法师吗？
choice_prompt:26:1410731018.male: Who gave you this courage? Was it you there, mage from the surface?
choice_prompt:26:1410731018.female: Who gave you this courage? Was it you there, mage from the surface?

say:27:1410731019:3.text: Yes, it was <style="stress"><player_name></style> who took Feli to the surface and for some reason, Feli began to show symptoms of transformation.
say:27:1410731019:3.male: Yes, it was <style="stress"><player_name></style> who took Feli to the surface and for some reason, Feli began to show symptoms of transformation.
say:27:1410731019:3.female: Yes, it was <style="stress"><player_name></style> who took Feli to the surface and for some reason, Feli began to show symptoms of transformation.

say:28:1410731020:1.text: But with his help, Feli returned unharmed.
say:28:1410731020:1.male: But with his help, Feli returned unharmed.
say:28:1410731020:1.female: But with her help, Feli returned unharmed.

say:30:1410731021:0.text: An outsider dares to think he can save the Essail clan on mere chance? Who's to say your actions didn't just delay his transformation?
say:30:1410731021:0.source_cn: 一个外来者，凭借一次侥幸，就想解救艾塞勒一族？
say:30:1410731021:0.male: An outsider dares to think he can save the Essail clan on mere chance? Who's to say your actions didn't just delay his transformation?
say:30:1410731021:0.female: An outsider dares to think she can save the Essail clan on mere chance? Who's to say your actions didn't just delay his transformation?

say:31:1410731022:0.text: I have struggled against this curse for thousands of years, only to see more of my people succumb to its corruption.
say:31:1410731022:0.source_cn: 千年间我一直在尝试破除诅咒，每次研究都造成更多的同胞孽化。

say:32:1410731023:0.text: Do you truly think I have not tried other means? Every lesser approach led only to tragedy.
say:32:1410731023:0.source_cn: 你以为我没有尝试过其他方法吗？所有温和的方案都以惨剧告终。

say:33:1410731024:0.text: Those who stood by my side, the Essail who knew the truth, chose to carry this secret to their graves.
say:33:1410731024:0.source_cn: 那些与我同行的人，那些知晓真相的艾塞勒，他们都选择将这...

say:34:1410731025:0.text: It is the path we have all chosen.
say:34:1410731025:0.source_cn: 这不是巧合，这是所有人的共识。

say:35:1410731026:0.text: If you genuinely wish to aid us, then accept reality. Here in Sal'thorin, survival is the only justice.
say:35:1410731026:0.source_cn: 如果你真的想帮助我们，就接受现实吧。在萨洛克兰，生存才...

say:37:1410731027:0.text: But the Sylvan Tendril really works! Feli...
say:37:1410731027:0.source_cn: 但织叶确实有效！斐利尔——

say:39:1410731028:0.text: Enough! Did you witness the curse being undone with your own eyes?
say:39:1410731028:0.source_cn: 够了！你亲眼见到了孽化解除吗？

say:43:1410731030:0.text: I saw it! I can prove it!

say:45:1410731031:0.text: Indris, would you truly cast aside the way that has sustained our people for thousands of years on the words of outsiders?
say:45:1410731031:0.source_cn: 因度厄，你要因为外来者的一面之词，否定千年来维系我族生...

say:47:1410731032:1.text: Your Majesty, the people have the right to know the truth. There's still hope.
say:47:1410731032:1.source_cn: 陛下，民众有知晓真相的权利。新的希望已然出现——

say:52:1410731034:1.text: Ah, I finally understand! The Divine Dew is her means of controlling Sal'thorin. She won't ever give it up!
say:52:1410731034:1.source_cn: 我算是明白了，恩典灵露现在可是她控制萨洛克兰的手段，她...

choice_prompt:53:1410731034.text: Ah, I finally understand! The Divine Dew is her means of controlling Sal'thorin. She won't ever give it up!
choice_prompt:53:1410731034.source_cn: 我算是明白了，恩典灵露现在可是她控制萨洛克兰的手段，她才不会放弃呢！

say:57:1410731037:0.text: It appears I must guide you once more.
say:57:1410731037:0.source_cn: 看来，是时候再度引领你们了……

choice:53:0:1.text: Words can only take you so far...
choice:53:0:1.male: Words can only take you so far...
choice:53:0:1.female: Words can only take you so far...

choice:53:1:2.text: I'll fight for what I believe in.
choice:53:1:2.male: I'll fight for what I believe in.
choice:53:1:2.female: I'll fight for what I believe in.

choice:26:0:1.text: Yes, he knows I have his back.
choice:26:0:1.male: Yes, he knows I have his back.
choice:26:0:1.female: Yes, he knows I have his back.

choice:26:1:2.text: I was able to lift Feli's curse.
choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 我曾用织叶解除了斐利尔的孽化
choice:26:1:2.male: I was able to lift Feli's curse.
choice:26:1:2.female: I was able to lift Feli's curse.

say:2:1410733002:0.text: Thador, take Indris away. Leave the lost child somewhere in the dark to ponder the cost of his betrayal.
say:2:1410733002:0.source_cn: 都铎，将因度厄押下去，让迷失的孩子在黑暗中思考背叛的代价。

say:3:1410733003:0.text: As for our two uninvited guests...
say:3:1410733003:0.male: As for our two uninvited guests...
say:3:1410733003:0.female: As for our two uninvited guests...

say:5:1410733004:1.text: I'm not one of yours, so your judgments mean squat to me!
say:5:1410733004:1.source_cn: 我可不是你们的人，少给我下判决。

say:7:1410733005:0.text: Very well. Velara, see that our dwarven friends take charge of them.
say:7:1410733005:0.source_cn: 如你所愿。奎茵，将他们交给我们的矮人朋友处理吧。

say:8:1410733006:0.text: I don't want this matter to attract any... unnecessary attention.
say:8:1410733006:0.source_cn: 我不希望这件事引起任何……不必要的关注。

say:12:1410733008:0.text: We'll take care of it, Your Majesty.
say:12:1410733008:0.source_cn: 我们会妥善处理的，陛下。

narration:13:1410733009:0.text: Velara finds Eldric, the dwarven chief, and hands you two over without a word...
narration:13:1410733009:0.source_cn: 奎茵找来了村长弗林，将我们移交了过去……

say:0:1410735101:0.text: It's too late to beg for mercy now!

narration:0:1410735301:0.text: Eldric takes you all back to the surface and then stops at the cliff beside the lift.
narration:0:1410735301:0.source_cn: 弗林带着你们返回了地表，随后在黑石升降井旁的悬崖边停下...

say:2:1410736002:0.text: You nearly destroyed everything I've worked for with the Essail. You'll pay for that.
say:2:1410736002:0.source_cn: 你们毁了我和艾塞勒的合作，你别想逃！我会亲自送你们上路！

say:3:1410736003:1.text: You want to kill me? You should've done it before I gathered all my knowledge, Eldric.
say:3:1410736003:1.source_cn: 想杀我？你还早了两百年！

say:4:1410736004:0.text: Next time you decide to end me, don't wait around—do it right! Fool.
say:4:1410736004:0.source_cn: 学不乖的蠢货，下次想杀你姑奶奶记得早点下手！

say:6:1410736006:0.text: Oh, wait. There won't be a next time.
say:6:1410736006:0.source_cn: 哦，不好意思，差点忘了说——没有下次！

say:2:1410738002:0.text: I found a <style="highlight">runestone</style> with the number two on it on Eldric!
say:2:1410738002:0.source_cn: 弗林身上藏有一块<style=highlight>符文...

say:3:1410738003:1.text: Keep it safe, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. This thing should unlock the mechanism that protects the Eclipsion.
say:3:1410738003:1.male: Keep it safe, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. This thing should unlock the mechanism that protects the Eclipsion.
say:3:1410738003:1.female: Keep it safe, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. This thing should unlock the mechanism that protects the Eclipsion.

say:6:1410738005:0.text: Oh, you can still speak... Well, let me take care of that for you.
say:6:1410738005:0.source_cn: 竟然还能说话……我让你说——

say:11:1410738007:1.text: Ah, finally some peace and quiet. Don't worry, he's not dead. I only hit him with the back end of my hammer. He might not wake up for another two days though, but when he does, he's gonna have a splitting headache. Ha!
say:11:1410738007:1.source_cn: 很好，我这一锤子正中后脑勺，就算他在后脑勺嵌了钢板，也...

choice_prompt:12:1410738007.text: Ah, finally some peace and quiet. Don't worry, he's not dead. I only hit him with the back end of my hammer. He might not wake up for another two days though, but when he does, he's gonna have a splitting headache. Ha!
choice_prompt:12:1410738007.source_cn: 很好，我这一锤子正中后脑勺，就算他在后脑勺嵌了钢板，也得给我晕个两天。

say:13:1410738008:0.text: I'll bring him back to Brimstone Village and explain everything to the people there. You need to go and save Indris first.
say:13:1410738008:0.source_cn: 我要把他带回深岩村，向那里的人说明一切，你先去救因度厄。

say:15:1410738009:0.text: Yeah, I got it. This is a serious matter.
say:15:1410738009:0.source_cn: 知道，事关重大，我会谨慎行动。你也要小心。
say:15:1410738009:0.male: Yeah, I got it. This is a serious matter.
say:15:1410738009:0.female: Yeah, I got it. This is a serious matter.

say:16:1410738010:0.text: Though the path ahead is uncertain, let's do this—let's turn this underground world upside down!
say:16:1410738010:0.source_cn: 虽然前路未知……但之后，我们一起给这地底闹个天翻地覆吧！
say:16:1410738010:0.male: Though the path ahead is uncertain, let's do this—let's turn this underground world upside down!
say:16:1410738010:0.female: Though the path ahead is uncertain, let's do this—let's turn this underground world upside down!

say:17:1410738011:0.text: It's time to show these fungus-eaters what the real sky looks like!
say:17:1410738011:0.source_cn: 是时候让那群地底之蛙见识见识真正的天空了！
say:17:1410738011:0.male: It's time to show these fungus-eaters what the real sky looks like!
say:17:1410738011:0.female: It's time to show these fungus-eaters what the real sky looks like!

choice:12:0:1.text: What are you going to do with him?
choice:12:0:1.male: What are you going to do with him?
choice:12:0:1.female: What are you going to do with him?

say:5:1410712001:1.text: There is no path. Maybe we can just swim over.
say:5:1410712001:1.source_cn: 没有路啊……干脆游过去吧！

say:6:1410712002:1.text: The surrounding waters are full of dragon egg essence. It's an extremely powerful medium for magic and is meant as a protective barrier.
say:6:1410712002:1.source_cn: 你最好清醒一点，周围的池水全是龙蛋清，那是极为浓郁的魔...

say:7:1410712003:1.text: Hey, I'm magicless! What's there to be afraid of?
say:7:1410712003:1.source_cn: 我又感知不到魔力，怕什么！

say:8:1410712004:1.text: Although you can't sense magic and your mind won't be affected, the magic can still affect your body.
say:8:1410712004:1.source_cn: 就算无法感知，顶多是精神不受影响，魔力依然可以影响你的肉体。

say:9:1410712005:1.text: The worst-case scenario is that you turn into a monster. If that happens, I get to send you to meet your ancestors.
say:9:1410712005:1.source_cn: 最坏的结果是你变成怪物。那我会立刻送你与祖先们团聚。

say:11:1410712007:0.text: Do you think there might be a mechanism nearby? Let's look around and see if we find one.
say:11:1410712007:0.source_cn: 你不是说过，这附近很可能有机关？仔细找找吧。

narration:15:140107109:0.text: Eclipsion is lying in the pool, covered in dark energy.
narration:15:140107109:0.source_cn: 你们看到了池中的杜恩加尔，上面的确缠绕了一些邪恶的气息。

say:9:1410720003:0.text: Is it possible that Feli's spirit is still with us? Is he trying to speak to us through the Sylvan Tendril?
say:9:1410720003:0.source_cn: 难道斐利尔的灵魂还在我们身边，他是不是想通过织叶与我们...

say:2:1410724001:1.text: How could there be a dragon here? These are the queen's chambers!
say:2:1410724001:1.source_cn: 这里怎么会有一头龙……这里可是女王的寝殿！

choice_prompt:3:1410724001.text: How could there be a dragon here? These are the queen's chambers!
choice_prompt:3:1410724001.source_cn: 这里怎么会有一头龙……这里可是女王的寝殿！

say:5:1410724003:1.text: Queen Seralyth of Sal'thorin, of course!
say:5:1410724003:1.source_cn: 当然是萨洛克兰的女王——奈萨雷斯！

say:6:1410724004:1.text: So you're telling me your queen likes to keep dragons in her chambers...?
say:6:1410724004:1.source_cn: 你们的女王，在寝殿里，养了，一头……龙？

say:7:1410724005:1.text: She must be quite the conservationist, then. Next, you'll tell me she keeps golden moles in her closet.
say:7:1410724005:1.source_cn: 哇哦，她真是爱惜濒危物种呢！

say:8:1410724006:1.text: I'm in no mood for jokes!

say:9:1410724007:1.text: You must understand that the queen's chambers are a place of great reverence, and only a few have ever been granted entry.
say:9:1410724007:1.source_cn: 你要知道女王的寝殿尊贵无比，到访过此处的人屈指可数！

say:10:1410724008:1.text: Right, this odd hobby of raising pet dragons must be kept a secret.
say:10:1410724008:1.source_cn: 养龙这种爱好的确不能被你们知道。

say:12:1410724010:1.text: The halls may be lined with guards and servants, yet if you consider it carefully, aside from the elders and a handful of nobles, none of us have ever stood in the queen's presence.
say:12:1410724010:1.source_cn: 尽管外围有守卫和侍从，但仔细想来，除了那几位长老和部分...

say:13:1410724011:1.text: We were told that Her Majesty had fallen ill, having given herself to grant us life, and thus wished to remain undisturbed by the public.
say:13:1410724011:1.source_cn: 我们得到的说辞是，女王陛下为了赐予我们生命力，身体一直...

say:14:1410724012:1.text: What if... it's not that Her Majesty couldn't see anyone but that she couldn't be seen...
say:14:1410724012:1.source_cn: 如果……女王并非不想见人，而是不能见人呢？

say:15:1410724013:1.source_cn: 等等……我好像懂了！因度厄，你是说……

say:16:1410724014:1.text: Helthor's beard! You're not saying what I think you're saying!
say:16:1410724014:1.source_cn: 赫托的胡子！赫托的铁锤！赫托，总之赫托在下！你是说——

say:18:1410724016:0.text: But how could the queen be a dragon? Oh, no, what if the dragon eggs came from...
say:18:1410724016:0.source_cn: 但女王怎么会是龙……？我们喝的龙蛋，难道是——

say:25:1410724017:3.text: Did I not warn you long ago?
say:25:1410724017:3.source_cn: 我不是早就警告过你了吗……

say:26:1410724018:0.text: Why are you here?! Where did you come from?!
say:26:1410724018:0.source_cn: 怎么是你？你从哪里冒出来的！

say:27:1410724019:1.source_cn: 是你们不该出现在这里。

say:28:1410724020:2.text: These are the queen's chambers. No one is allowed to enter without permission.
say:28:1410724020:2.source_cn: 此为女王寝殿，不得擅自闯入。

say:30:1410724021:1.text: High Priestess Velara, General Thador, it seems that you both have known about this for quite a while but chose to hide it.
say:30:1410724021:1.source_cn: 奎茵冕下，都铎将军，你们早就知道这一切，却选择了隐瞒吗？

say:31:1410724022:0.text: Indris, none in the Essail clan hold the right to pass judgment upon the queen. We have placed our faith in her, as should you.
say:31:1410724022:0.source_cn: 因度厄，艾塞勒的任何生灵都无权评判女王。我们只是选择了...

say:33:1410724023:0.text: Oh, great! Here we go again—Feli's killer is back and spouting more twisted nonsense!
say:33:1410724023:0.source_cn: 好啊！杀害斐利尔的凶手，又开始说这些蛊惑人心的疯话了！

say:34:1410724024:2.text: The foolish have squandered their chance for redemption. Thador, erase this threat before it festers.
say:34:1410724024:2.source_cn: 愚昧之人已经丧失了被引入正途的价值。都铎，是时候将威胁...

narration:38:14010724:0.text: While you all are talking, High Priestess Velara and Thador arrive, flanked by soldiers.
narration:38:14010724:0.source_cn: 你们交谈之际，奎茵和都铎带来了人马挡住了你们的去路。
narration:38:14010724:0.male: While you all are talking, High Priestess Velara and Thador arrive, flanked by soldiers.
narration:38:14010724:0.female: While you all are talking, High Priestess Velara and Thador arrive, flanked by soldiers.

narration:39:14010724:0.text: While you all are talking, High Priestess Velara and Thador arrive, flanked by soldiers.
narration:39:14010724:0.source_cn: 你们交谈之际，奎茵和都铎带来了人马挡住了你们的去路。
narration:39:14010724:0.male: While you all are talking, High Priestess Velara and Thador arrive, flanked by soldiers.
narration:39:14010724:0.female: While you all are talking, High Priestess Velara and Thador arrive, flanked by soldiers.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1410730001:.text: Drink it. The spring water from the surface.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1410730001:.source_cn: 喝下吧，这地表清澈的泉水……

say:4:1410730101:0.text: Do you see now? This is Misarte's curse.
say:4:1410730101:0.source_cn: 看到了吗？这就是弥萨忒的诅咒。

say:5:1410730102:0.text: Absurd, isn't it? This pristine water, the simplest gift in all the world, is the very source of our clan's curse.
say:5:1410730102:0.source_cn: 多么讽刺啊……地表的清水，这世间最普通的恩赐，却是我族...

say:6:1410730103:0.text: It begins with unbearable pain, followed by madness, and eventually... the emergence of a mindless monster.
say:6:1410730103:0.source_cn: 一开始是剧痛，随后是疯狂，最后……沦为失去理智的怪物。

say:7:1410730104:0.text: Two millennia past, I led the fiercest of our clan from our homeland, and yet... fewer than one in ten reached Sal'thorin alive.
say:7:1410730104:0.source_cn: 两千年前，我带领着最骁勇的绿裔战士们离开故土，可最终…...

say:8:1410730105:0.text: Yet, fortune smiled upon us this time, and I found a dragon—or, more precisely, the slumbering form of the Primordial Dragon.
say:8:1410730105:0.source_cn: 命运此时却再度眷顾了我们，我找到了龙，准确地说，是沉睡...

say:9:1410730106:0.text: I do not know why it rests here, but I pray it never awakens.
say:9:1410730106:0.source_cn: 我不知道它为何在此沉睡，但我希望它永远不要醒来。

say:10:1410730107:0.text: Because the power of dragons is enough to challenge even the gods. With the Primordial Dragon, we, the Essail, shall no longer suffer the curse of Misarte!
say:10:1410730107:0.source_cn: 因为龙之力足以与神明相抗，利用初始之龙，艾塞勒将再也不...

say:11:1410730108:0.text: The Primordial Dragon's power was beyond my grasp, but I did not falter. Instead, I seized control of the magic and life force contained within the dragon eggs.
say:11:1410730108:0.source_cn: 但初始之龙的力量太过强大，难以驾驭。我不得不退而求其次...

say:12:1410730109:0.text: After countless failures, I triumphed. The Divine Dew was finally brought into existence.
say:12:1410730109:0.source_cn: 经过千百次的失败，我成功了。恩典灵露，终于诞生了。

say:13:1410730110:0.text: Do you believe I am simply boasting of my accomplishments? No...
say:13:1410730110:0.source_cn: 你们以为我在夸耀自己的功绩吗？不——

say:14:1410730111:0.text: The Divine Dew is the salvation I forged with my own hands, not a gift from the gods, but from me alone...
say:14:1410730111:0.source_cn: 恩典灵露是我亲手酿造的救赎。不靠神明，而是我——

say:15:1410730112:0.text: Now, the Essail rises with new life!
say:15:1410730112:0.source_cn: 赐予了艾塞勒一族的新生！

say:16:1410730113:0.text: At this moment, you shall witness the power of divine grace with your own eyes.
say:16:1410730113:0.source_cn: 此刻，就让你们亲眼见证恩典的力量。

say:17:1410730114:0.text: Give this one the Divine Dew. Let the other show you...
say:17:1410730114:0.source_cn: 给这一位灵露。而另一位，就让他向诸位展示——

say:18:1410730115:0.text: ...the fate of those forsaken by the divine.

cinematic_dialogue:21:1410730001:.text: Drink it. The spring water from the surface.
cinematic_dialogue:21:1410730001:.source_cn: 喝下吧，这地表清澈的泉水……

narration:23:14010725:0.text: The two Essail drink from the surface water, and their forms start to warp with corruption. The Divine Dew saves one, but the other succumbs to the dark transformation, only to be struck down by Thador's hand.
narration:23:14010725:0.source_cn: 两个艾塞勒喝下地表清水后开始孽化，其中一个摄入了恩典灵...
narration:23:14010725:0.male: The two Essail drink from the surface water, and their forms start to warp with corruption. The Divine Dew saves one, but the other succumbs to the dark transformation, only to be struck down by Thador's hand.
narration:23:14010725:0.female: The two Essail drink from the surface water, and their forms start to warp with corruption. The Divine Dew saves one, but the other succumbs to the dark transformation, only to be struck down by Thador's hand.

narration:24:14010725:0.text: The two Essail drink from the surface water, and their forms start to warp with corruption. The Divine Dew saves one, but the other succumbs to the dark transformation, only to be struck down by Thador's hand.
narration:24:14010725:0.source_cn: 两个艾塞勒喝下地表清水后开始孽化，其中一个摄入了恩典灵...
narration:24:14010725:0.male: The two Essail drink from the surface water, and their forms start to warp with corruption. The Divine Dew saves one, but the other succumbs to the dark transformation, only to be struck down by Thador's hand.
narration:24:14010725:0.female: The two Essail drink from the surface water, and their forms start to warp with corruption. The Divine Dew saves one, but the other succumbs to the dark transformation, only to be struck down by Thador's hand.

say:5:1410735001:0.text: Eldric, you scoundrel! How dare you appear before me!
say:5:1410735001:0.source_cn: 弗林……你这混球，还敢出现在我的面前！

say:6:1410735002:0.text: What in Helthor's name have these cretins done now? How dare they try to destroy the ties between our people?!
say:6:1410735002:0.source_cn: 这些混蛋都做了什么好事！竟敢破坏我们两族的关系！

say:8:1410735003:0.text: High Priestess Velara, I swear I'll make sure they regret what they've done!
say:8:1410735003:0.source_cn: 奎茵大祭司，放心吧！我一定好好处理他们！

say:9:1410735004:0.text: Chief Eldric, Her Majesty has decided to leave these two in your hands to prevent diplomatic discord.
say:9:1410735004:0.source_cn: 弗林先生，女王陛下担忧引起外交纠纷，所以特意将此二人转...

say:10:1410735005:0.text: I hope you understand her painstaking efforts. After all, some things shouldn't happen in Sal'thorin...
say:10:1410735005:0.source_cn: 希望您能明白她的苦心，毕竟有些事情不该在萨洛克兰发生……

say:11:1410735006:0.text: Understood. You can rest assured that I will handle everything personally from here.

say:17:1410735008:0.text: It seems some dwarves don't know their manners, Chief Eldric, and may need to be taught.
say:17:1410735008:0.source_cn: 弗林先生，有些矮人不懂礼数，看来还需要好好管教。

say:18:1410735009:0.text: Yes, High Priestess. Once we return, I will ensure she receives a proper lesson.
say:18:1410735009:0.source_cn: 大祭司说得对。回去后我一定好好……教训她。

say:19:1410735010:0.text: It's getting late. I'll take them up first and offer you my apologies later.
say:19:1410735010:0.source_cn: 时候不早了，我们先带他们上去，之后再给您赔罪！

say:20:1410735011:0.text: I look forward to hearing from you soon. Farewell.
say:20:1410735011:0.source_cn: 那就期待您的好消息了，再会。

narration:24:14010726:0.text: Velara hands you over to Eldric.
narration:24:14010726:0.source_cn: 奎茵将你们移交给了弗林。
narration:24:14010726:0.male: Velara hands you over to Eldric.
narration:24:14010726:0.female: Velara hands you over to Eldric.

narration:25:14010726:0.female: Velara hands you over to Eldric.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410723001:.text: Look! There's a dragon over there!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1410723002:.text: Don't wake it up! Let's go!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410723002:.male: Don't wake it up! Let's go!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1410723002:.female: Don't wake it up! Let's go!
